title: Unbelievably Smoky American Pork Back Ribs Grill
description: A classic American dish featuring charred pork back ribs with a cheesy twist, perfect for midnight cravings. This high-protein-friendly recipe is sure to satisfy your hunger.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 275 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs and apply the dry rub mixture evenly.
Place the ribs on the grill and close the lid, cooking for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, brush the ribs with barbecue sauce and continue cooking for another 30 minutes.
While the ribs are cooking, melt the manteca in a saucepan over low heat.
Add the shredded cheddar cheese to the melted manteca and stir until well combined and emulsified.
Once the ribs are done, brush them with the cheese and manteca mixture.
Return the ribs to the grill and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
